question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is-'following'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given options, the correct option to fill in the blank is 'following'.
 
• **Following **here has been used as an **adjective **which is qualifying the noun** 'day'. **
 
• It means** next in time.**

​ Example: The **following **day there was a ceremony in St Peter's Square&
